instructions: In the image at screenshot: Do photographs that sit together as one set, such as a row of cards or a gallery, have clearly different colour treatments, for example one warm and faded, one cold and blue, one black and white, or one heavily saturated?

criteria.true: Photographs shown together as one set have clearly different colour treatments, so they look as if they were edited separately and do not belong to one set.
criteria.false: Photographs shown together as one set share a similar colour treatment, or the page shows no set of photographs.

instructions: In the image at screenshot: Do images that sit together as one set, such as a row of cards, mix different rendering styles, for example a photograph next to a flat vector illustration next to a glossy 3D render?

criteria.true: Images shown together as one set mix different rendering styles, such as photograph, flat illustration, and 3D render, so the set does not look like one family.
criteria.false: Images shown together as one set all use the same rendering style, or the page shows no set of images.

instructions: In the image at screenshot: Is a photograph or picture on the page visibly stretched or squashed out of its natural proportions, or blurry and blocky because a small image was enlarged?

criteria.true: A photograph or picture on the page is visibly distorted out of its natural proportions, or is blurry and blocky as if a small image were enlarged too far.
criteria.false: Every photograph or picture on the page keeps its natural proportions and looks sharp at the size it is shown.

instructions: In the image at screenshot: Does the large hero image or banner look flat and murky, with almost everything in it at a similar middle lightness and no clear light areas and dark areas?

criteria.true: The hero image or banner is flat and murky: most of it sits at a similar middle lightness, with no clear light areas and dark areas to give it shape.
criteria.false: The hero image or banner has a clear range of light areas and dark areas, or the page has no hero image or banner.

instructions: In the image at screenshot: Do icons that sit together as one set mix very different levels of detail, for example simple outline icons next to detailed, shaded, many-coloured icons?

criteria.true: Icons shown together as one set mix very different levels of detail, so some are simple and plain while others are detailed and elaborate, and the set does not look like one family.
criteria.false: Icons shown together as one set share a similar level of detail and style, or the page shows no set of icons.

instructions: In the image at screenshot: Is text or other content placed over a busy, detailed background, such as a strong pattern or a cluttered photograph, so the background competes with what sits on it?

criteria.true: Text or other content sits over a busy, detailed background, such as a strong pattern or a cluttered photograph, that competes with it for attention.
criteria.false: Text and other content sit on plain, quiet, or softened backgrounds that do not compete with them.
